linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04, SteamOS 3.0, or later
  • Processor: Intel i3 / AMD Ryzen 3
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 6GB / RX 580 8GB
  • Additional Notes: We recommend a GPU with at least 6GB of VRAM, so the entire game can run on it.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04, SteamOS 3.0, or later
  • Processor: Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 / RX 7600
  • Additional Notes: We recommend a GPU with at least 6GB of VRAM, so the entire game can run on it.
